# Script excerpt (seed, original)

[0:00] Over one, the ball curves late and the batter is beaten. Over
forty, the same bowler runs in — and the ball barely moves. What changed?

[0:22] Not the bowler. The ball. Its shiny side has roughened, the seam
has softened, and the swing that won the morning has gone. Unless the
fielding side has looked after one side of it — then the old ball can
start talking again, the other way.
